project.title: More Culling
project.description: A mod that changes how multiple types of culling are handled in order to improve performance
project.body: ### A mod that changes how multiple types of culling are handled in order to improve performance Culling is when you don't render things that the player can't see, to improve performance Requires Cloth Config! **Make sure to report any bugs [here](https://github.com/fxmorin/moreculling/issues)!** **Discord Server:** [https://discord.gg/SGFDrvA](https://discord.gg/SGFDrvA) **Head over to the [wiki](https://github.com/fxmorin/MoreCulling/wiki) for information on:** What's Culled, Performance, Compatibility, Bug Fixes, and more! Check out [MoreCullingExtra](https://modrinth.com/mod/morecullingextra) for extra culling features ## My other optimizations/fixes * [MemoryLeakFix](https://modrinth.com/mod/memoryleakfix) - Fixes multiple memory leaks for both the client and server * [Carpet-Fixes](https://modrinth.com/mod/carpet-fixes) - Largest Server-Side bug fixing mod * [Blanket](https://modrinth.com/mod/blanket) - Client-side tweaks/fixes * [RailOptimization](https://modrinth.com/mod/rail-optimization) - Make powered rails less laggy ## More Info Feel free to contribute to the project! I'm also fine if you use this mod in your modpacks, just make sure to mention it. However I don't allow clients or other mods to merge this mod without permission, if you would like to use this mod in your client or another mod please contact me. --- For transparency, I give my maintainer (1Foxy2) 75% of profits on modrinth.

gallery.title: [Vanilla] Block Culling
gallery.description: Minecraft does block culling in order to render as little as possible. Although they do a pretty bad job at it and lots of blocks render faces you can't see

gallery.title: [MoreCulling] Block Culling
gallery.description: MoreCulling removes most faces using aggressive block culling. It's able to get much higher frames in most areas of the game, without changing any visuals.

gallery.title: [Vanilla] Map Culling
gallery.description: Minecraft does not cull stuff like maps behind blocks, causing huge performance loss for no reason

gallery.title: [MoreCulling] Map Culling
gallery.description: MoreCulling correctly culls there maps, and does the same for signs. Resulting in a much smoother and faster game

gallery.title: [Vanilla] Item Frames
gallery.description:
Item Frames are generally known as being really laggy in minecraft.
Also causes very unstable FPS resulting in frame freezing

gallery.title: [MoreCulling] Item Frames
gallery.description:
MoreCulling handles item frames very aggressively. It's able to properly optimize the rendering to make sure your game stays smooth and consistent.
Find out more at: https://github.com/fxmorin/MoreCulling/wiki/Item-Frame-Culling#comparing-performance

gallery.title: [Vanilla] Beacon Beams
gallery.description: The terrible beacon rendering performance in Vanilla

gallery.title: [MoreCulling] Beacon Beam Culling
gallery.description: MoreCulling adds frustum culling to beacon beams.

versions.name: MoreCulling - v1.0.0-beta.1 for 1.21.1
versions.changelog:
**Big Update**
MoreCulling now has a maintainer @1foxy2 and thanks to them, this release adds NeoForge support!
Along with many bug fixes.

**Bugs Fixed:**
- #293 Item frames not culling with sodium v0.6.0
- #292 - BlockState culling not working with sodium v0.6.0
- #294 - End rods not culling properly
- #274 #291 - Crashes if Fabric API isn't present
- #295 - Fixed the back of item frames not culling
- #248 - TextOffset in sodium menu is now fixed

**Removed 2 options:**
- Powder snow culling - Had harsh conflicts with sodium and wasn't up to standards.
- Entity model culling - Resulting in multiple bugs, and wasn't useful unless you weren't using sodium.

versions.name: MoreCulling - v0.21.0 for 1.20.[0-4]
versions.changelog:
**New Culling options:**
- End Gateway culling - [#167](https://github.com/FxMorin/MoreCulling/issues/167)
- Beacon Beam culling - [#191](https://github.com/FxMorin/MoreCulling/issues/191)

**Changes:**
- Fixes some blocks not culling if texture has unused transparency - [#154](https://github.com/FxMorin/MoreCulling/issues/154)
- Fixed being able to see some culling in item frames when close - [#163](https://github.com/FxMorin/MoreCulling/issues/163)
- Fixed edge case where blocks with transparent texture prevents culling - [#166](https://github.com/FxMorin/MoreCulling/issues/166)
- Fixed item frames rendering at the wrong place when really far away

versions.name: MoreCulling - v0.13.0 for 1.19.3
versions.changelog:
**Changes:**  
- Large optimizations to cache (faster culling)  
- Multipart & Weighted models now cache per side, allowing tons more blocks to cull  
- Shulkerboxes cull on the bottom face  
- Tons of edge-cases culled without performance loss, such as: [Pressure plates should cull the tops of fences and walls](https://github.com/fxmorin/MoreCulling/issues/91)  
  
**Fixes:**  
- Some textures not culling due to translucency even when covered by other textures  
- Some faces without `cullface` where being culled  
- [#124](https://github.com/fxmorin/MoreCulling/issues/124) Leaves and powered snow sometimes culled incorrectly  
- [#127](https://github.com/fxmorin/MoreCulling/issues/127) Some blocks without collision where still not culling correctly  
  
**API Changes:**  
- `MoreBlockCulling` & `MoreStateCulling` now have a `shouldAttemptToCull` which accepts direction  
- `MoreStateCulling` now also has `canCull`

versions.name: MoreCulling - v0.8.0
versions.changelog:
This is a huge release with tons of performance boosts and a huge API extension!  
  
**Changelog:**  
- HUGE blockstate culling optimizations  
- Huge Leave Culling optimizations (_All methods render less faces without any visual changes_)  
- Better powder snow culling  
- New Button to allow you to reset all MoreCulling cache  
  
**API Changes:**  
- `MoreBlockCulling` & `MoreStateCulling`  
  - New method `shouldAttemptToCull`  
  - New method `cantCullAgainst`  
- `BakedOpacity`  
  - New method `hasTextureTranslucency(BlockState)`  
  - New method `getModels`  
- `SpriteOpacity`  
  - New method `hasTranslucency`  
- New API `ExtendedItemRenderer`  
  - `getBakedQuadColorCache`  
  - `customGetModel`  
  - `renderBakedItemQuad`  
  - `renderBakedItemQuadsWithoutFace`  
  - `renderBakedItemModelWithoutFace`  
  - `renderBakedItemQuadsForFace`  
  - `renderBakedItemModelForFace`  
  - `renderBakedItemQuadsFor3Faces`  
  - `renderBakedItemModelOnly3Faces`  
  - `renderItemFrameItem`  
    
**Fixes:**  
 [#56](https://github.com/fxmorin/MoreCulling/issues/56) MultiPartBakedModels now cull  
WeightedBakedModel now culls correctly  
Not all the options reload the renderer correctly  
Mangrove Roots option was skipping some options incorrectly & not saving  
Fixed multiple issues where some blocks would not cull due to overlapping texture layers (_like grass_)

**API Changes:**

Many back-end changes where made to allow even more states and blocks to cull in many new scenarios. Enjoy!

versions.name: MoreCulling - v0.1.2
versions.changelog:
### Fixes:
- Fabric-Api support, now supports the Indigo renderer. (Although it's very slightly slower than vanilla)
- Now extending the BakedModel so that custom modded models no longer crash the game

### Known Issues:
- [Some rendering engines & mods are not currently supported](https://github.com/fxmorin/MoreCulling/issues/6). Although, they should still run without issues and may sometimes still provide small optimizations.

### Compatibility:
[This issue](https://github.com/fxmorin/MoreCulling/issues/6) has an up-to-date list of mods that break MoreCulling's optimizations.
It would be very helpful if you could help update the list. 

### Upcoming:
I will probably work on supporting modded models more, by providing an API for mods to use, and internal compatibility for specific mods like `LambdaBetterGrass`
